title: Tracy Sun (Poshmark co-founder) — 'Don't let certainty replace curiosity.'
summary: Tracy Sun — co-founder of Poshmark — posts a reflection from her Unprecedented Lunch with Eric (hosted by Leah Solivan at Precedent.vc) on the subtle hubris of believing you must be right because you're following the playbook, and on Eric's takeaway: spread ideas worth spreading.
blockquote:
Best practices are a starting point, not a substitute for judgment.

Later in the conversation, I asked Eric how people can support authors who take the time to explore ideas and put them out into the world.

His answer was simple: if you encounter an idea worth spreading, spread it.

So I'm doing that here.

Don't let certainty replace curiosity.
